text: Naomi Fitzwilliam, Cinder Labs' Security Lead, plans two separate rounds of checking for EmberStake -- not one.
First, a Hardhat test suite that proves the contract works correctly for normal, well-intentioned usage.
Second, a dedicated audit milestone scheduled before mainnet -- Slither static analysis, plus Naomi actively trying to break it herself.
The goal is stated plainly: this contract has to survive someone actively trying to break it, not just normal usage.
Next: planning the indexer that watches this contract, and the deployment pipeline that gets it onto Base.
